title: Distance from Earth
text: On a Mars transit a message takes 4 to 22 minutes each way, so no reply comes sooner than about 8 to 44 minutes, with blackouts on top.
The crew must assess, decide and act alone; this app's offline scoring and cited next steps exist for exactly that gap.
Queue every report and measurement for delivery; the app sends them when the link returns.

citations.source: NASA Human Research Program: the five hazards of human spaceflight — distance from Earth.
